title: Stretch: Rehabilitation & Risk
welcome_lead: Stretch further — manage rehab, risk and return to play.
meta_desc: GCSE PE Sports Injuries stretch: rehab, return to play, risk course.
final_note: Outstanding! You can plan recovery and return to play safely.

concepts.def: Phased recovery from injury back to performance.
Manual treatment to restore movement and strength.
Cold therapy — reduces swelling and pain.
Safe step-by-step return after injury or concussion.

walkthroughs.body_html: Rehab usually has three phases: acute (RICE, pain control), recovery (gentle movement, physio), functional (sport-specific drills before return to play). Skipping phases risks re-injury.
Hyperthermia (overheating) risks heat exhaustion or heatstroke — hydrate and use lighter kit. Hypothermia (severe cold) requires layers, warm drinks and shelter. Assess weather before training.

After concussion, athletes follow a graduated return-to-play protocol over several days: rest, light aerobic, sport-specific drills, non-contact training, full contact, then play. Any symptoms returning mean dropping back a stage.
